text: In accordance with the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo Procedural By-law Section 9, the Board: 1. At the first meeting of the Board, after the appointment of the Chair, shall elect a Vice-Chair whose term of office shall be two years unless the Board otherwise specifies. All members are eligible for election.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Elected Dr. Cynthia Holmes as Vice-Chair of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo for a term of office starting February 28, 2025 and ending November 14, 2026 and until a successor is appointed.
